resolved.1_eligibility_order: Usable rows are ordered as the admission selection orders them: live claims first, then priority descending, then enqueue order (QueueItem.order); the work ledger's canonical-key ranking no longer orders them, only its readiness gates unclaimed rows. Test: an older same-priority work with the larger canonical key keeps the single slot over a newer, smaller-key work across three observations.
resolved.2_eligibility_enrollment: HostOwnerProfile::eligibility takes the shell's Enrollment; rows whose current work's actor or repository is not enrolled (or whose work is no longer current) wait without taking a slot, matching the selection's denial. Test: a de-enrolled actor's older row does not block another work.
resolved.3_docs: docs/fair-admission.md now states that an unacknowledged run (transport start, no workflow: lost dispatcher or unanswered exchange transport) is marked unknown by recover on lease expiry and released by reconcile-termination then host-owner-release, and restricts the permanent hold to an acknowledged run (recorded workflow) with no reconciled termination, candidate or retained worker observation whose lease expires.
resolved.4_start_route: kiln-implementer start now refuses with host_owner_out_of_band_start when the claim holds an unsettled Execution reservation on a host-owner campaign root account (fair_admission::holds_host_owner_reservation, recognised by the domain-tagged account identity). Without such a reservation the start path is unchanged apart from one read-only admission snapshot. Tests: the CLI host-owner test refuses start after a committed reservation; the existing non-host-owner start CLI test still passes; a core test recognises the host-owner reservation and not another claim. The rule is stated in docs/fair-admission.md and both fair-admission spec copies.

open_operational_limits: An acknowledged run (recorded workflow) with no reconciled termination, candidate or retained worker observation whose lease expires keeps its slot with no release path in this flow: Kiln #45 lease expiry does not mark it Unknown, so reconcile-termination cannot bind it.
